page: OVHcloud l4-180 is a GPU-accelerated server instance configured with 45 dedicated AMD EPYC 9454 physical cores operating at 2.75 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 180.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics processing is driven by two NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 48 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the dedicated AMD EPYC processor achieves top-tier status in both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU performance. Memory performance is highly competitive, with the Passmark memory score ranking in the top 10% and small-block read-only memory bandwidth placing in the top 25%. However, large-block uncached read-only memory bandwidth drops to average levels. The dual NVIDIA L4 GPUs enable top-tier performance in LLM inference tasks, processing prompts and generating text in the top 10% for small and medium models, and maintaining top-tier prompt processing for large 70B models.

The l4-180 offers a balanced resource density, pairing dedicated compute cores with dual mid-range enterprise GPUs. This configuration provides a cost-efficient alternative to high-end accelerator instances for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand massive H100-class memory bandwidth. The primary tradeoff is the moderate 400 GB local NVMe storage capacity, which may require external storage solutions for massive datasets. This server is optimized for LLM inference, machine learning workloads, ray tracing, and high-throughput database operations.
description: The OVHcloud l4-180 is a GPU-accelerated server featuring 45 dedicated AMD EPYC 9454 physical cores running at 2.75 GHz, 180.0 GB of system memory, and a 400 GB NVMe SSD. It is equipped with two NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a total of 48 GB of VRAM. In benchmark testing, the instance delivers top-tier CPU performance and memory scores, alongside top-tier LLM inference speeds for small, medium, and large models. While large-block uncached memory bandwidth remains average, the server's dedicated compute resources and dual GPUs offer high resource density. The l4-180 is highly suited for machine learning inference, data science, ray tracing, and database operations requiring dedicated hardware acceleration.
